chosen_variant_rule: fewest censored, then smallest sum of A-equivalents (a_apps + coarse_solves*4nnz(Lc)/(2nnz(A))) to target over E3 dev walls, cold RHS, dynamic operators

dynamics.push: v_x = 1 m/s on cells with centroid y > H - 0.25
trajectories: BDF2 1/480 with band eta 1e-2 from step 24 (steps 22..35)

geometry.construction: constrained RSA from scratch, generator-support distance >= 0.5 dmin on supported edges
geometry.representative: 1x4 d0.1 s1: + BDF2 and Newmark operators for h = 1/60, 1/480

methods.lambda_hat: 1.05 x 15-step Lanczos of D^-1/2 A D^-1/2, capped at 2
methods.two_level: P in {PR, SA}, s in {8, 16}, smoother in {GS fwd/bwd, Chebyshev deg 2 on [lam/8, lam]}, stationary or PCG

rhs: post-event: mid-height band eta = 1e-2, u0 = intact solution (same mu); P kept and strength-aware rebuild
